# Studio1

> DevRel and GitHub growth agency for devtool, AI, and open-source teams.

Studio1 helps developer-focused companies grow adoption through GitHub and open-source growth, technical content marketing, developer documentation and DX audits, developer video production, and developer relations campaigns. The team builds README and onboarding fixes, demo projects, tutorials, docs, videos, launches, community programs, and distribution across Reddit, daily.dev, X, LinkedIn, Dev.to, and live events.

Selected results: Memori grew from launch to 12,000+ GitHub stars. Corsair went from about 300 to 2,000 GitHub stars in five weeks. OpenLore grew from ~135 to 1,700+ GitHub stars in one month. Nebius's open-source examples library reached 16K+ GitHub stars. Every number, with sources, is on the Results page.

## Services

- [GitHub Growth Agency](https://www.studio1hq.com/github-growth-agency): Open-source and GitHub growth: README and onboarding fixes, demo projects, launch positioning, community distribution, talks, and hackathons.
- [Technical Content Marketing](https://www.studio1hq.com/technical-content-marketing): Developer tutorials, integration guides, SEO articles, and code-rich content written by engineers.
- [Developer Documentation & DX Audits](https://www.studio1hq.com/developer-documentation-dx-audit): Documentation audits, onboarding reviews, API clarity, quickstarts, reference docs, and developer experience improvements.
- [Developer Video Production](https://www.studio1hq.com/developer-video-production): Technical demos, product walkthroughs, long-form tutorials, Shorts, scripts, edits, thumbnails, and publishing support.
- [Developer Relations & Growth Campaigns](https://www.studio1hq.com/developer-relations-growth-campaigns): DevRel as a service: developer advocacy, community programs, product launches, organic growth campaigns, and creator programs.

## Results and case studies

- [Results](https://www.studio1hq.com/results): Every Studio1 result in one place, with links to case studies and public sources.
- [Memori](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/memori): 0 to 12,000+ GitHub stars through a community-led open-source launch; the Reddit launch post reached 50K+ impressions; 12 hands-on demo agents shipped.
- [Corsair](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/corsair): GitHub stars grew from about 300 to 2,000 in roughly five weeks through onboarding audits, example projects, README work, and student hackathons.
- [OpenLore](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/openlore): 12x GitHub star growth, from ~135 to 1,700+ in one month; 100K+ impressions across daily.dev, X, LinkedIn, and Reddit; #3 trending in Go on Trendshift.
- [Nebius](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/nebius): An open-source library of 130+ agent examples reached 16K+ GitHub stars and trended on GitHub twice; 29 framework integrations; 300+ deliverables over nearly two years.
- [Bright Data](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/brightdata): 50+ technical articles on brightdata.com over a year; 12 of 30 developer queries checked returned a Studio1 post in Google's top five results.
- [Entelligence AI](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/entelligence-ai): 304K+ Reddit impressions from technical blogs, deep dives, and developer distribution.
- [ScrapeGraphAI](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/scrapegraph): 265K+ social and community reach from practical AI agent demo projects.
- [Permit.io](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/permit): First-page Google rankings for high-intent authorization queries such as "RBAC in Supabase".
- [LiteLLM](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/litellm): Documentation revamp with separate SDK and Gateway quickstarts, publicly endorsed by LiteLLM's CEO.
- [Webcrumbs](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/webcrumbs): Comparison SEO content for "v0 alternative" searches, distributed across DEV and Medium.
- [Tensorlake](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/tensorlake): Diagram-led AI infrastructure tutorials that surfaced in Google results for high-intent developer searches.
- [Ittybit](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/ittybit): Team-facing cookbooks and code examples verified against product behavior.
- [Jozu](https://www.studio1hq.com/case-studies/jozu): DevRel for KitOps: DevFest Pune and KubeCon India representation, Jozu Champions program support, and technical content.

## Guides

- [How to Launch a Developer Tool on Product Hunt](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/product-hunt-launch-playbook): A step-by-step launch playbook: prep, the listing, launch day, Show HN and launch week, with results from Webcrumbs and Permit.io.
- [How to Get More GitHub Stars for Your Open-Source Launch](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/how-to-get-github-stars-open-source-launch): A step-by-step playbook: prelaunch prep, README, Show HN, Reddit, X, Product Hunt, demos, and community loops, with results from Memori, OpenLore, and Corsair.
- [How to Get Your Tool Recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/how-to-get-your-tool-recommended-by-chatgpt-perplexity-google): AEO, GEO, crawler access, documentation strategy, comparison pages, community mentions, schema, and llms.txt for developer tools.
- [How to Measure Your Devtool's Visibility in AI Answers](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/how-to-measure-devtool-visibility-in-ai-answers): A two-hour spreadsheet audit of how often AI tools mention, recommend, link to, and accurately describe your devtool.
- [Developer Docs as Your Best AEO Asset](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/developer-docs-as-aeo-asset): How to structure developer documentation so AI answers cite it.
- [llms.txt Explained](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/llms-txt-explained-developer-tools-guide): What llms.txt is, whether it improves AI visibility or SEO, and a practical template for developer tools.
- [Fractional DevRel](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/fractional-devrel): What fractional DevRel is, what it costs, and who it is for.
- [DevRel Agency vs In-House DevRel Hire](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/devrel-agency-vs-in-house-devrel-hire): Costs, timelines, and when each option fits.
- [DevRel vs Developer Marketing](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/devrel-vs-developer-marketing): The difference between DevRel and developer marketing, and how strong teams combine both.
- [Common Mistakes Startups Make When Building Developer-First Products](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/common-mistakes-developer-products): Developer adoption mistakes around onboarding, docs, communities, awareness, and DevRel timing.
- [How Developer Tool Companies Can Measure Content ROI Beyond Pageviews](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/developer-tool-content-roi-beyond-pageviews): Measuring developer content ROI through intent, activation, and adoption.
- [Why Active Developer Communities Matter for Early-Stage Startups](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/why-developer-communities-matter): How DevRel, trust, technical education, and open communities help early developer products grow.
- [Why Software Companies Are Doubling Down on Content in 2026](https://www.studio1hq.com/blog/why-software-companies-invest-in-content): Why content compounds for software and devtool companies, and which types convert.
